Hi Kris,

I hope you are having a great week. My name is Marcos Gonzalez and I am the Managing Attorney at GovSpring Legal, where we help federal contractors keep evolving regulations from slowing down operations. I would like to commend Systex's nearly five decades of work with NIH, and in particular the long-running relationship with NIAID building and maintaining CRIMSON. With that contract well into its performance period, I wanted to check in on how things are going. A decades-long, sole-source relationship built on unique system knowledge is exactly the kind of arrangement that draws government scrutiny or attention from competing offerors. Organizational conflict-of-interest questions are far easier to keep clean with counsel on call than to untangle after a contracting officer or competitor raises them. We help firms like yours stay ahead of all of it, so the technical work never slows down.

I would love to introduce myself and see how we might support Systex going forward. Let me know if you would like to discuss any legal issues, free of charge. I'm available next week, and you can schedule a call here or call me at (202) 407-3556. You can also read more about my associate and I on our webpage.

I have CC'd my associate and my law clerk, who would also participate in any scheduled call.

Warmly,
Marcos Gonzalez
Managing Attorney
GovSpring Legal
